April 8th, 2026[Dashboard](https://www.artillery.io/changelog/tag/dashboard)


# Stash viewer


You can now browse, search, and inspect data stored with the[Stash API](https://www.artillery.io/docs/reference/stash) from Artillery Cloud. Open **Stash** in the sidebar to view the keys and values available to your organization.
